description: This file contains JavaScript code for a Gmail bookmarklet that interacts with the Vtiger CRM web service. It includes functions for making XMLHttpRequests, managing sessions, querying and creating records in Vtiger, and UI interactions for selecting and creating email records within the CRM.

classes.name: XHR
classes.description: A wrapper for XMLHttpRequest supporting both ActiveXObject and standard XMLHttpRequest, with methods to load requests and handle state changes.

classes.name: VtigerWebservice
classes.description: A class to interact with the Vtiger CRM web service, supporting session extension, querying, and record creation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Main initialization function that sets up the bookmarklet, manages session, and UI interactions.

methods.name: XHR.load
methods.description: Loads an XMLHttpRequest asynchronously or synchronously, with callback handling.

methods.name: XHR.readyStateChange
methods.description: Handles the ready state change of the XMLHttpRequest, invoking callback on success.

methods.name: VtigerWebservice.extendSession
methods.description: Extends the session with the Vtiger web service.

methods.name: VtigerWebservice.query
methods.description: Performs a query operation on the Vtiger web service.

methods.name: VtigerWebservice.create
methods.description: Creates a new record in Vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getGmailSubject
methods.description: Extracts the email subject from the Gmail tab title.

methods.name: getVtigerBaseURL
methods.description: Determines the base URL of the Vtiger CRM instance.

methods.name: getVtigerURL
methods.description: Constructs the full web service URL for Vtiger.

methods.name: getGmailURL
methods.description: Gets the current Gmail URL, stripping query and hash parameters.

methods.name: showBookMarkletUI
methods.description: Displays the bookmarklet UI element.

methods.name: hideBookMarkletUI
methods.description: Hides the bookmarklet UI element.

methods.name: destroyBookMarkletUI
methods.description: Removes the bookmarklet UI iframe from the DOM.

methods.name: showBusy
methods.description: Displays a 'Working...' indicator during processing.

methods.name: hideBusy
methods.description: Hides the 'Working...' indicator.

methods.name: createBookMarkletUI
methods.description: Initializes the UI components and event handlers for the bookmarklet.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds a query string for searching Vtiger records based on user input.

methods.name: displaySearchResult
methods.description: Displays search results in the UI and handles selection.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets selected entity details into form fields.

methods.name: closeOnSuccess
methods.description: Handles the response after creating an email record, showing success or error.

methods.name: getTodayDate
methods.description: Returns the current date in DD-MM-YYYY format.

methods.name: createEmail
methods.description: Collects email data from form and creates a new email record in Vtiger.
